Usage: ls [OPTION]... [FILE]...
List things (synthetic sample in GNU --help format).

  -a, --all                  include hidden entries
  -A, --almost-all           like -a, minus . and ..
      --color[=WHEN]         colorize; WHEN is always, auto or never
  -h, --human-readable       with -l, sizes like 1K 2M
  -l                         long listing
  -t                         sort by time
  -1                         one entry per line
      --help        show this help and exit
